Synopsis:
    Active US-Iran military exchange has escalated sharply. The US struck Iranian targets including near Sirik (Hormozgan province), killing civilians including wedding attendees. Iran's IRGC retaliated with missile and drone strikes on US bases across Kuwait, Jordan, Bahrain, and Iraq's Erbil. Trump issued extreme escalation threats including near-total destruction of Iran. The Strait of Hormuz is under effective US operational control per Trump, with Iranian mining attempts already intercepted. A Saudi-flagged oil tanker was struck in the Strait, killing two Filipino crew. Brent crude surged to $97/bbl (+4.6%). Diplomatic channels (Pakistan, SCO summit) remain active but fragile — a prior Islamabad MoU ceasefire collapsed. Iranian president signals openness to deal revival, but the IRGC posture remains aggressive.
